mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate over the prior month signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.1 percentage points over the prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 9.0% for three consecutive months, it signals a weak labor market that prompts the Federal Reserve to maintain accommodative policy, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where UNRATE exceeds 9.0% for three consecutive months, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates weakening consumer demand, triggering a sell-off in equities and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS decline by at least 1.0% from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 93.0, it signals a manufacturing slowdown that reduces near-term corporate earnings growth, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where INDPRO < 93.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts (HOUST) signals strong consumer confidence and rising disposable income, boosting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of instances where HOUST increases by at least 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI inflation exceeds 2.5%, it signals persistent inflation that may prompt Federal Reserve tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 2.5%, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) and increase in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals monetary policy uncertainty, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days due to rate hike concerns.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL increases by at least 0.5% from prior month, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS < 50.0), the weak labor market signals reduced consumer spending power, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances where PAYEMS < 50.0, or Rank IC over 3-year rolling window is below 0.05.
